blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose F M C W - L I O , a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs. To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations. FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.
blocks.zh: 常规的LiDAR-惰性偏振仪(LIO)或同时定位和绘图(SLAM)方法严重依赖环境的几何特征,因为LiDARs主要提供测距而不是运动测量. 然而,从现在开始,由于小说"频率调制连续波(FMCW)"多普勒LiDARs,情况发生了变化. FMCW多普勒LiDARs不仅以高分辨率提供点范围,而且通过多普勒效应捕获即时点多普勒速度. 在信里,我们提出F M C W - L I O, 一个新颖和强壮的LIO, 利用FMCW 多普勒LiDARs的内在测量. 为了正确利用多普勒速度,设计了运动补偿方法,并采用了多普勒辅助的观察模型来进行狂妄状态估计. 然后,动态点可以通过多普勒标准有效去除,得出更一致的几何观测结果. FMCW-LIO最终实现了准确的状态估计和静态映射,甚至在结构脱产环境中也是如此. 在各种场景中进行了广泛的实验,FMCW-LIO在准确性和稳健性上都超过了其他算法.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Laser Light Detection And Ranging (LiDAR) sensors are indispensable and play a crucial role in robotics and automation. In recent years, LiDAR sensors have undergone dramatic innovations with more advanced features. Among them, a remarkable milestone is the technology of Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDAR that can capture both the range and radial Doppler velocity of points based on the modulation and demodulation of laser waves in frequency domain [ 1 ] [ 2 ] . Additionally, the FMCW Doppler LiDAR shows promise of miniaturization, thus holding significant potential in robotic applications.
blocks.zh: 激光光探测和测距(LiDAR)传感器是不可或缺的,在机器人和自动化方面发挥着至关重要的作用. 近年来,LiDAR传感器经历了具有更先进特性的戏剧性创新. 其中,一个引人注目的里程碑是频率调制连续波技术。 多普勒LiDAR可以同时根据频率域激光波的调制和降级来捕捉射点的射程和射线多普勒速度[1][2]. 此外,FMCW Doppler LiDAR还展示了微型化的前景,从而在机器人应用方面具有巨大潜力。

blocks.en: The new dimension of Doppler velocity in the FMCW Doppler LiDAR implicitly conveys the motion information of the LiDAR, which opens up new pathways for robotic perception and state estimation. Consequently, numerous unexplored topics arise in the integration of conventional methods, previously dominated by geometric feature-based methods, with the intrinsic Doppler velocity. Besides, FMCW Doppler LiDARs can output precise range sensing of massive points with significantly high temporal-spatial resolution. On the other hand, FMCW Doppler LiDARs possess the inherent capability to measure the Doppler velocity. More importantly, Doppler measurements can provide a direct observation of the LiDAR motion state (LiDAR velocity), which has a correspondence-free nature. The correspondence-free observation is irrelevant to the locally geometric features (e.g., line or plane features) of the surrounding environment. As a result, FMCW Doppler LiDARs, representing the next generation of laser sensing technology, hold the potential to address various challenging issues in the conventional LiDAR field, including the degeneracy and dynamic problem [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 多普勒速度的新维度在FMCW多普勒LiDAR中隐含地传达了LiDAR的运动信息,为机器人感知和状态估计开辟了新的途径. 因此,在传统方法的结合中出现了许多未经探讨的专题,这些方法以前以几何特征方法为主,具有内在的多普勒速度。 此外,FMCW 多普勒LiDARs可以输出具有显著的高时间空间分辨率的大规模点的精确射程感测. 另一方面,FMCW多普勒LiDARs拥有测量多普勒速度的固有能力. 更重要的是,多普勒测量可以提供对LiDAR运动状态(LiDAR速度)的直接观测,这种运动状态具有无通信性质. 无通信观测与周边环境的局部几何特征(如线或平面特征)无关. 因此,代表下一代激光感应技术的FMCW Doppler LiDARs具有解决常规LiDAR领域各种挑战性问题的潜力,包括退化和动态问题[2].

blocks.en: In this work, harnessing the advantages of FMCW Doppler LiDAR and Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU), we propose a Doppler LiDAR-inertial odometry and static mapping framework. The contributions can be summarized as follows: 1. A robust Doppler-aided LIO, F M C W - L I O , is proposed for FMCW Doppler LiDAR systems. To our knowledge, FMCW-LIO is the first framework for FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial state estimation and static mapping. 2. To precisely utilize Doppler velocities in an accumulated LiDAR scan, a novel motion compensation method for Doppler measurements is designed by fusing with IMU. Notably, beyond motion compensation, the proposed Doppler relationship essentially reveals the interrelation between Doppler velocities of a static point with respect to different LiDAR frames. 3. A Doppler-aided observation, integrated in the on-manifold Iterated Error-State Extended Kalman Filter (IESEKF), and an efficient dynamic point removal method are exploited to obtain consistent geometric observations and static maps. 4. Comprehensive experiments on multiple mobile platforms equipped with an FMCW Doppler LiDAR are conducted to validate and demonstrate the effectiveness, accuracy, and robustness of the proposed framework. 5. The source code of FMCW-LIO, the data sequences, the integrated framework of FMCW-LIO with Free-Init , and the experiment video are made publicly available (see the Resources section for details).
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,利用FMCW Doppler LiDAR和惯性测量单元(IMU)的优势,我们提出了多普勒LiDAR惯性测量和静态绘图框架. 这些贡献可归纳如下: 1. 建议为FMCW多普勒LiDAR系统建立一个强大的多普勒辅助LIO(F M C W-L I O). 据我们所知,FMCW-LIO是FMCW Doppler LiDAR-惰性状态估计和静态绘图的第一个框架. 2. 为了在累积的LiDAR扫描中精确地利用多普勒速度,设计了一种新的多普勒测量运动补偿方法,方法是与IMU相接。 值得注意的是,除了运动补偿外,拟议的多普勒关系基本上揭示了一个静点速度与不同的LiDAR框架之间的相互关系。 3. 利用了多普勒辅助观测法,将这种观测法纳入 " 斜面误差 -- -- 状态扩展卡尔曼过滤器 " ,并采用有效的动态点清除方法,以获得一致的几何观测和静态地图。 4. 在配备FMCW Doppler LiDAR的多个移动平台上进行全面试验,以验证和证明拟议框架的有效性、准确性和稳健性。 5. FMCW-LIO的源代码,数据序列,FMCW-LIO与Free-Init的综合框架,以及实验视频被公开(详见资源部分).

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: In this section, we review the most related works focusing on LiDAR-inertial odometry, FMCW Doppler LiDAR-based algorithms and datasets, and recent works on automotive radar-inertial odometry.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们回顾了最相关的以LiDAR-惰性偏振学,FMCW Doppler LiDAR-基于算法和数据集,以及汽车雷达-惰性偏振学近期的著作.

blocks.en: II-A LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
blocks.zh: II-A LiDAR-惯性测量

blocks.en: To handle dynamic motions of robots, the tightly-coupled LiDAR-inertial fusion has attracted significant research attention. LIO-SAM [ 3 ] employs a factor-graph framework, and it can also fuse Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) and loop closure factors. LIO-mapping [ 4 ] uses the IMU pre-integration in a constrained refinement on estimation and mapping. LINS [ 5 ] introduces a framework based on the IESEKF to recursively update the state, but it heavily relies on the ground assumption. In [ 6 ] , authors apply the IESEKF and a novel Kalman gain formulation for efficient computing. FAST-LIO2 [ 7 ] further enhances the performance by using a direct scan-to-map observation model and the incremental k-dimensional tree ( ikd-Tree ) for the online map. Faster-LIO [ 8 ] uses an incremental voxel map (iVox) to achieve higher search speed. Point-LIO [ 9 ] uses a point-wise framework and a novel IMU modeling method that allows a high-frequency odometry output. A hierarchical geometrical observer and a higher-order motion correction are applied in [ 10 ] which can efficiently improve the estimation accuracy and map quality.
blocks.zh: 为了处理机器人的动态运动,紧密交织的LiDAR-惰性聚变引起了大量的研究关注. LIO-SAM [3]采用了一个系数图框架,它也可以将全球导航卫星系统(GNSS)和环闭塞因子连接起来. LIO-映射[4]在对估计和映射进行有限的改进时,使用IMU预集. LINS [5]引入了一个基于IESEKF的框架,以递归更新状态,但它在很大程度上依赖于地面假设. 在[6]中,作者应用了IESEKF和一部小说Kalman获得的配方来高效计算. FAST-LIO2[7]通过使用直扫描到映射观测模型和在线地图的增量k维树(ikd-Tree),进一步提高了性能. 更快-LIO [8]使用递增的voxel映射(iVox)来实现更高的搜索速度. Point-LIO [9] 使用点心框架和新颖的IMU建模方法,允许高频率的odometh输出. 在[10]中采用了分级几何观察器和更高顺序的运动修正,可以有效地提高估计准确度和地图质量.

blocks.en: II-B FMCW Doppler LiDAR-based Algorithms and Datasets
blocks.zh: II-B FMCW 多普勒 LiDAR 基于算法和数据集

blocks.en: Recently, DICP [ 2 ] introduces a variant of conventional geometric Iterative Closest Point (ICP) methods by including a Doppler objective function in the registration problem, revealing significant improvements in accuracy even in feature-denied scenes. Guo et al. [ 11 ] propose a velocity estimation and clustering framework with Doppler velocities in the CARLA simulation [ 12 ] . Gu et al. [ 13 ] present a moving-object tracking method using an FMCW Doppler LiDAR. In [ 14 ] and [ 15 ] , authors present a continuous-time LiDAR odometry (LO) and a velocity estimator supporting Doppler measurements. In [ 16 ] , authors use FMCW Doppler LiDARs to simultaneously estimate the kinematic state and the shape of moving objects. More recently, Jung et al. [ 17 ] release a heterogeneous LiDAR dataset (HeLiPR) for place recognition tasks, including an FMCW Doppler LiDAR. However, HeLiPR is not appropriate for online state estimation because the velocity of points is the post-processed absolute velocity using external sensors, instead of the raw Doppler velocity measurement.
blocks.zh: 最近,DICP[2]引入了常规几何迭代近距离点(ICP)方法的变体,在注册问题上加入了一个多普勒客观功能,揭示出即使在被特征否定的场景中,准确性也有很大的提高. 郭等编. [11] 在CARLA模拟中提出一个与多普勒速度的快速估计和集群框架[12]. 顾等. [13] 呈现一种使用FMCW多普勒LiDAR的移动对象跟踪方法. 在[14]和[15]中,作者呈现了一个连续的LiDAR odomethy(LO)和一个支持多普勒测量的速度估计器. 在[16]中,作者使用FMCW Doppler LiDARs同时估计运动状态和移动对象的形状. 最近,郑等人. [17] 发布一个异样的LiDAR数据集(HeLiPR),用于位置识别任务,包括一个FMCW Doppler LiDAR. 然而,HeLiPR不适合在线状态估计,因为点的速度是使用外部传感器处理后的绝对速度,而不是原始的多普勒速度测量.

blocks.en: II-C Automotive Radar-Inertial Odometry
blocks.zh: II-C 汽车雷达惯性测量

blocks.en: 3D or 4D imaging radars can measure the position and Doppler velocity of points similar to FMCW Doppler LiDARs, but the point density is far less than that of FMCW Doppler LiDARs. In [ 18 ] [ 19 ] , authors propose EKF-based radar-inertial odometry (RIO) systems, with ego-velocity estimates. In [ 20 ] , authors use the radar intensity in the RIO. Ng et al. [ 21 ] propose a radar-inertial odometry which uses a continuous-time framework. Lately, 4D iRIOM [ 22 ] shows the impressive localization and mapping accuracy of a RIO, integrated with the scan-to-submap matching and loop closure modules.
blocks.zh: 3D或4D成像雷达可以测量类似于FMCW Doppler LiDARs的点的位置和多普勒速度,但点密度远低于FMCW Doppler LiDARs. 在[18][19]中,作者提出了基于EKF的雷达-惰性偏振(RIO)系统,并附有自负-速度估计. 在[20]中,作者使用RIO中的雷达强度. Ng et al. [21] 提议采用连续时间框架的雷达惯性偏振测量法。 最近,4D iRIOM [22] 显示一个RIO的令人印象深刻的本地化和映射精度,与扫描到子映射匹配和循环关闭模块融合.

blocks.en: III System Overview
blocks.zh: 三. 系统概览

blocks.en: The system overview is illustrated in Fig. 2 . FMCW-LIO takes 6-axis IMU signals as system inputs. LiDAR scans from an FMCW Doppler LiDAR are fed into the motion compensation to correct the distortion of position and Doppler measurements. The undistorted scans are first used in the LiDAR velocity observation model. Adopting the updated velocity, potential dynamic points in the scan can be removed, according to raw Doppler measurements. Then, the remaining static points are sent to the LiDAR geometric observation, resulting in more accurate and consistent associations for the second state update and static mapping. Overall, the Doppler-aided FMCW-LIO can achieve accurate and robust state estimation and output a consistent, neat, and static map.
blocks.zh: 图2说明了系统概况。 FMCW-LIO以6轴的IMU信号作为系统输入。 从FMCW Doppler LiDAR的LiDAR扫描被输入运动补偿,以纠正位置扭曲和Doppler测量. 未经保存的扫描最早用于LiDAR速度观测模型. 采用更新速度,扫描中的潜在动态点可以根据原始多普勒的测量结果去除. 随后,剩余的静态点被送入LiDAR几何观测,使得第二次状态更新和静态映射的关联更加准确一致. 总体而言,多普勒援助的FMCW-LIO可以实现准确而稳健的状态估计,并输出一个连贯,整齐,静态的地图.

blocks.en: IV-C 1 Motion Compensation for Doppler Measurements
blocks.zh: IV-C 1 多普勒计量法的动议赔偿

blocks.en:
A generic LiDAR usually returns accumulated scans at a fixed frequency (e.g., 10 Hz), instead of returning each individual LiDAR point separately. The system is propagated from the last update at the last scan-end time t k − 1 t_{k-1} until the current scan arrives at time t k t_{k} .
However, although a LiDAR scan arrives at a certain time, each LiDAR point in this scan is sampled at its individual discrete time. Hence, for a moving LiDAR, each point is sampled with respect to the LiDAR position at its sampling time, instead of the LiDAR position at the scan-end time. To exactly use LiDAR points in state update, we need to correct point positions in a scan by motion compensation.

一个通用的LiDAR通常以固定频率(如10Hz)返回累积扫描,而不是将每个单个的LiDAR点分别返回. 系统从上次扫描结束时间 t k − 1 t_{k-1} 的最后一次更新中传播到当前扫描到达时间 t k t_{k} 。
然而,虽然LiDAR扫描在一定时间到达,但这个扫描中每个LiDAR点都是在单个离散时间取样的. 因此,对于移动的LiDAR,每个点在采样时都对LiDAR位置进行取样,而不是扫描末时的LiDAR位置。 为了在状态更新中精确使用LiDAR点,我们需要通过运动补偿扫描纠正点位置.

IV-D Dynamic Point Removal and Static Mapping
blocks.zh: IV-D 动态点清除和静态绘图

blocks.en: The LiDAR geometric observation in ( 14 ) depends on the online established map. Dynamic points in the LiDAR scan can break the static world assumption and introduce significant errors. Importantly, dynamic points can contaminate the online map, which is prone to provide erroneous geometric correspondences. This dependence creates a loop between the state estimate and the map that can destabilize the system, as shown in the left of Fig. 3 . Specifically, if the state estimate is disturbed by dynamic points, the online map will be inaccurate and chaotic, and the erroneous correspondences from dynamic points will amplify the estimation error. This positive feedback loop of the estimation error may lead to divergence even failure of the state estimator.
blocks.zh: (14)中的LiDAR几何观测依赖于在线既定地图. LiDAR扫描中的动态点可以打破静态世界假设,引入重大错误. 重要的是,动态点会污染在线地图,这容易提供错误的几何对应. 这种依赖性在状态估计和地图之间形成了一个循环,可以破坏系统的稳定,如图3左边所示. 具体来说,如果状态估计受到动态点的干扰,在线地图就会不准确和混乱,来自动态点的错误对应会扩大估计错误. 这种对估计误差的正面反馈循环可能导致差异,甚至导致状态估计器的失败.

blocks.en: Significantly, as shown in ( 11 ) and ( 17 ), this cosine reveals a crucial physical insight: the effectiveness and the signal-to-noise ratio of a LiDAR point in estimating the 3D linear LiDAR velocity depend on the angle (relative direction) between the point direction and the LiDAR velocity projected in the LiDAR frame (i.e., 𝐯 w ​ l l {{}^{l}{\mathbf{v}}_{wl}} ), rather than directly on the LiDAR velocity projected in the world frame (i.e., 𝐯 w ​ l w {{}^{w}{\mathbf{v}}_{wl}} ) or the Field-of-View (FoV) of an FMCW Doppler LiDAR. Meanwhile, this cosine represents the radial nature of the Doppler effect.
blocks.zh: 值得注意的是,如(11)和(17)所示,这种余弦揭示了关键的物理洞察力:LiDAR点在估计3D线性LiDAR速度时,其有效性和信号与噪声之比取决于该点方向与LiDAR框架(即v w l l l l l l l l monthb{v}}_{wl}})中预测的LiDAR速度之间的角度(相对方向),而不是直接依赖于世界范围内预测的LiDAR速度(即w l w w w }{\w monthb{v}}_{wl}})或FMCW Doppler LiDAR的F-of-Vew(FoV). 同时,这种余弦代表了多普勒效应的光圈性质.

blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果

blocks.en: V-A FMCW Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Data Collection
blocks.zh: V-A FMCW 多普勒 LiDAR 惯性 数据收集

blocks.en: It is necessary to collect the FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial data in the real world to validate the proposed method, due to the absence of public FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial datasets including raw Doppler measurements, as mentioned in Section II-B . We use an Aeva Aeries II [ 26 ] FMCW Doppler LiDAR and an Xsens MTi-G-710 IMU to assemble our sensor suite. This sensor suite can be mounted on handheld or wheeled platforms, as in Fig. 4 . The LiDAR FoV is 120 ∘ × \times 28.8 ∘ . The LiDAR returns 10 Hz scans including position and raw Doppler measurements. The frequency of IMU measurements is 200 Hz. The computing device is the Intel NUC with an i7-1165G7 CPU.
blocks.zh: 如第二-B节所述,由于缺少公共的FMCW 多普勒 多普勒 LiDAR - 惰性数据集,包括原始多普勒测量数据,因此必须在现实世界中收集FMCW 多普勒 LiDAR - 惰性数据以验证拟议方法. 我们使用一个Aeva Aeries II [26] FMCW Doppler LiDAR和一个Xsens MTi-G-710 IMU来组装我们的传感器套房. 这种传感器套件可以挂在手持式或轮式平台上,如Fig. 4,LiDAR FOV为120××××时28.8××××. LiDAR返回10Hz扫描,包括位置和原始多普勒测量. IMU测量的频率为200赫兹. 计算设备为英特尔NUC,具有i7-1165G7 CPU.

blocks.en: The data description is shown in Table I . For the handheld platform, the sensor suite is held by a walking person with persistent shaking and swing. The speed of the handheld platform is slow (about 1.5 m/s). For the wheeled platform, the sensor suite is mounted on a vehicle and the moving speed is relatively fast (up to 7.0 m/s). To comprehensively evaluate different algorithms, diverse conditions (structured vs. structure-degenerated scenes, wide vs. narrow scenes, slow vs. fast speeds) are considered, as shown in Fig. 5 . In campus_01 and campus_02 , we traverse the campus of the University of Macau and the scene is wide enough to extract and match geometric features for general LIO systems. On the contrary, street_01 and street_02 are collected in narrow streets in downtown Macao, thus the scene is considerably narrow leading to significant challenges for LIO systems. Furthermore, to validate the Doppler-aided observation, four structure-degenerated sequences are collected in a subaqueous pedestrian tunnel. The tunnel is S-shaped and the one-side length is about 850 m. Since the dataset is challenging and the GNSS accuracy is highly unreliable in these narrow, among-building, or indoor scenes, we choose the trajectory optimized by offline post-processing as the ground-truth reference. We utilize a state-of-the-art loop closure [ 27 ] and the pose graph optimization [ 28 ] to generate the ground truth. Notably, all post-processed ground-truth trajectories are meticulously examined to ensure alignment with the real world. Besides, we use two metrics, absolute translational error (RMSE) and end-to-end error (E2E) [ 7 ] , to evaluate algorithms. Therefore, the starting and ending positions of all sequences are confirmed to be exactly coincident to enable the end-to-end evaluation.
blocks.zh: 数据说明见表一。 对于手持平台,感应套房由一个持续摇晃和摇摆的步行者持有. 手持式平台的速度很慢(约1.5 m/s). 对于轮式平台,传感器套件安装在车辆上,移动速度相对较快(最高可达7.0 m/s). 为了全面评价不同的算法,考虑了不同的条件(结构化的对结构解生成的场景,宽的对狭的场景,慢的对快的速度),如图5所示. 在校园_01和校园_02中,我们穿越澳门大学校园,场景宽广,可以提取和匹配一般LIO系统的几何特征. 与此相反,澳门市中心狭窄的街道收集街道_01和街道_02,因此场景相当狭窄,导致LIO系统面临重大挑战. 此外,为了验证多普勒辅助的观测结果,在一条水下行人隧道中收集了四个结构脱落的序列. 隧道为S形,单侧长度约850米. 由于数据集具有挑战性,而且全球导航卫星系统的准确性在这些狭窄的建筑间或室内场景中极不可靠,我们选择离线后处理最优化的轨迹作为地面实况参考。 我们利用最先进的环闭 [27] 和姿势图优化 [28] 生成地面真相。 值得注意的是,对所有经过处理后的地面真实轨迹都进行了认真审查,以确保与现实世界保持一致。 此外,我们使用两个度量衡,绝对翻译错误(RMSE)和端对端错误(E2E)[7],来评价算法. 因此,确认所有序列的起始和结束位置完全吻合,以便能够进行端到端的评价。

blocks.en: For the thorough evaluation and ablation study of different algorithms and modules, we compare FMCW-LIO with conventional mainstream LIO systems under diverse framework designs, i.e., LINS [ 5 ] , LIO-SAM [ 3 ] , DLIO [ 10 ] , and FAST-LIO2 [ 7 ] . We also evaluate the recently released Doppler-aided LO, STEAM-DICP [ 14 ] , which can serve as an ablation study to validate the role of IMU on handheld or small and medium-scale robot platforms with narrow sensing FoV, narrow workspaces, and high-frequency dynamic motions. We tune the parameters of all algorithms to achieve their optimal accuracy and use these tuned parameters in all experiments. In FMCW-LIO, we use ikd-Tree [ 7 ] as the map structure, and the local map size is set to 1000 m. We also test two variants of FMCW-LIO to perform ablation studies and validate the effectiveness of two modules, including 1) the variant without the Doppler compensation (w/o DC) and 2) the variant without the dynamic point removal (w/o DR).
blocks.zh: 为了对不同的算法和模块进行全面评估和扩展研究,我们将FMCW-LIO与各种框架设计下的传统主流LIO系统进行比较,即LINS [5],LIO-SAM [3],DLIO [10],以及FAST-LIO2 [7]. 我们还评价最近发布的多普勒辅助LO,STEAM-DICP[14],这可以作为验证IMU在手持式或中小型机器人平台上作用的模拟研究,具有狭义感知FOV,狭小的工作空间,以及高频动态运动. 我们调谐所有算法的参数,以实现它们的最佳准确性,并在所有实验中使用这些调谐参数. 在FMCW-LIO中,我们使用ikd-Tree[7]作为地图结构,本地地图大小设定为1000米. 我们还测试FMCW-LIO的两个变体,以进行减速研究并验证两个模块的有效性,包括1)没有多普勒补偿(w/o DC)的变体和2)没有动态点去除(w/o DR)的变体.

blocks.en: V-B Experiments in Structured Environments
blocks.zh: 结构化环境中的V-B实验

blocks.en: The results in four structured scenes are in the left four columns of Table II and the loop closure of LIO-SAM is disabled for fair comparisons. FMCW-LIO achieves accuracy comparable to FAST-LIO2 in campus scenes. However, in street_01 , the narrow scene and intense on-stairs motions (as shown in Fig. 5 (c)) result in failures or large drifts of other algorithms, but FMCW-LIO can achieve remarkably low errors. The reason is that, in street_01 , the sensor suite faces a feature-less wall within an extremely narrow scene which leads to erroneous or invalid geometric observations (as in Fig. 5 (d)). Nevertheless, FMCW-LIO can use the Doppler-aided LiDAR velocity observation that is independent of the geometric features of environments. Meanwhile, the LiDAR velocity observation can perform the Zero-Velocity Update (ZUPT) when the platform is steady when facing the wall or offer z z -axis velocity when a large motion in the z z direction occurs. As a result, the estimated trajectory of FMCW-LIO can exactly return to the starting position.
blocks.zh: 四个结构场景的结果在表二的左侧四栏中,LIO-SAM的循环关闭被禁用以进行公平比较. FMCW-LIO在校园场景中实现了与FAST-LIO2相当的精度. 然而,在街机_01中,狭窄的场景和强烈的楼梯运动(如图5(c)所示)会导致其他算法的失败或大漂移,但FMCW-LIO可以实现明显低级的错误. 原因是,在街机_01中,感应套房在一个极其狭小的场景中面对一个没有特征的墙壁,导致错误或无效的几何观测(如图5(d)). 尽管如此,FMCW-LIO仍可以使用独立于环境几何特征的多普勒辅助的LiDAR速度观测. 同时,LiDAR速度观测可以在月台面对墙面时稳定时进行零速度更新(ZUPT),或者在z方向发生大运动时提供z-轴速度. 因此,FMCW-LIO的估计轨迹可以完全回到起始位置.

blocks.en: In addition, due to the presence of numerous moving pedestrians and cars in street sequences, the variant (w/o DR) exhibits larger localization errors. Conversely, the complete FMCW-LIO and the variant (w/o DC) achieve accurate estimation performance. In structured sequences, the Doppler compensation effect is not significant due to the slow-moving speeds of both handheld and wheeled platforms operating within the campus or street blocks. Hence, the variant (w/o DC) achieves comparable accuracy with the complete FMCW-LIO. The mapping results of FMCW-LIO in structured scenes are shown in Fig. 6 and the average running time per scan of algorithms is listed in Table III . FMCW-LIO can achieve real-time and efficient performance that is comparable to that of FAST-LIO2. Online demonstrations can be found in the video.
blocks.zh: 此外,由于有许多行人和汽车在街道序列中移动,变体(w/o DR)显示出更大的本地化错误. 反之,完整的FMCW-LIO和变体(w/o DC)则实现了准确的估计性能. 在结构化序列中,多普勒补偿效果并不显著,因为手持平台和轮式平台在校园或街道街区内运行的速度都缓慢. 因此,变体(w/o DC)与完整的FMCW-LIO具有相当的准确性。 FMCW-LIO在结构场景中的映射结果以图6显示,每扫描算法的平均运行时间见表三. FMCW-LIO可以实现实时高效的性能,与FAST-LIO2相当. 在线演示可见于视频.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we observe that STEAM-DICP demonstrates estimation accuracy comparable to other LIO methods in campus_01 . However, in other sequences, it fails when encountering dynamic motions, fast rotations, or narrow scenes due to the lack of keypoints. In campus_02 , STEAM-DICP can successfully run up to the halfway point, until rapid rotations occur. Thus, we only calculate the RMSE of the segments where it can successfully run without system failures. Therefore, it can be observed that IMU is essential for handheld or robotic platforms that frequently encounter narrow workspaces and highly dynamic motions.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们还注意到,STEAM-DICP显示的估计精度与校园01的其他LIO方法相当。 然而,在其他序列中,它遇到动态运动,快速旋转,或因缺少键位而出现狭长场景时失败. 在校园_02中,STEAM-DICP可以成功运行到中点,直到发生快速旋转. 因此,我们只计算它能够顺利运行而不发生系统故障的各段的RMSE. 因此,可以说,IMU对于经常遇到狭窄的工作空间和高度动态运动的手持或机器人平台至关重要.

blocks.en: V-C Experiments in Structure-Degenerated Environments
blocks.zh: V-C 结构生成环境中的实验

blocks.en: To further validate the Doppler-aided observation model, we evaluate algorithms on four tunnel sequences targeting geometric structure-degenerated scenes. These sequences have diverse distributions in length and moving speed. The results are shown in the right four columns of Table II . As expected, all conventional LIO systems that depend on geometric observations fail in most tunnel sequences. FMCW-LIO, however, accomplishes incredibly low errors, accurately returning to starting points. In the shortest sequence tunnel_02 , LIO-SAM can achieve accurate localization with a factor graph framework which can maintain relatively long-term constraints in this short length. Although DLIO and FAST-LIO2 do not fail, they fail to achieve accurate localization, generating chaotic, inconsistent and drifted tunnel maps, as in Fig. 1 (a)(c). In the longest sequence tunnel_04 , FMCW-LIO can perfectly achieve precise localization (2 cm end-to-end error over 1.7 km traversed round-trip distance) through the whole tunnel. The Doppler-aided observation provides a direct observation of the LiDAR velocity state. However, in long tunnel sequences, the factor graph framework in LIO-SAM that only relies on geometric features also proves ineffective in handling incorrect correspondences. Finally, FMCW-LIO can generate a neat, complete, and consistent map of the whole tunnel (as shown in Fig. 1 (d)), and the estimated tunnel length is highly close to the real data. Trajectories of algorithms overlaid with a satellite map are shown in Fig. 7 . It can be found that FMCW-LIO outputs a precious trajectory accurately aligned with the tunnel ends while other algorithms suffer from severe drifts in such structure-degenerated scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步验证多普勒辅助观测模型,我们对针对几何结构脱产场景的四个隧道序列进行算法评价. 这些序列在长度和移动速度上有着不同的分布. 结果见表二右四栏。 如预期,所有依赖几何观测的常规LIO系统在大多数隧道序列中都失败. 然而,FMCW-LIO实现了惊人的低差错,准确地回到起点。 在最短的序列隧道_02中,LIO-SAM可以通过一个因子图框架实现准确的本地化,这个框架可以保持这个短长的相对长期的限制. 尽管DLIO和FAST-LIO2没有失败,但它们未能实现准确的本地化,生成混乱,不一致和漂移的隧道图,如图1(a)(c). 在最长的顺序隧道_04中,FMCW-LIO可以完美地通过整个隧道实现精确的本地化(2厘米端到端误差超过1.7公里的绕行距离). 多普勒辅助观测提供了对LiDAR速度状态的直接观测. 然而,在长隧道序列中,LIO-SAM中仅依赖几何特征的因子图框架也证明在处理不正确的函证时无效. 最后,FMCW-LIO可以产生整齐,完整,连贯的全隧道地图(如图1(d)所示),估计隧道长度与真实数据高度接近. 图7显示带有卫星图的算法轨迹。 可以看到,FMCW-LIO输出出一个与隧道终点精确对齐的珍贵轨迹,而其他算法则在这样的结构脱产场景中遭受严重的漂移.

blocks.en: Similarly, STEAM-DICP can only achieve successful running up to the halfway point of each tunnel sequence. When the platform executes a U-turn to return, STEAM-DICP fails due to the narrow scene, fast rotations, and a scarcity of keypoints. Despite STEAM-DICP achieving a halfway success in tunnel sequences compared to conventional LIO methods, it still exhibits significant drifted errors, especially in the z z -axis. We only compute the RMSE of the successful segments for STEAM-DICP. An insight from the results is that while the LiDAR-only continuous-time model of STEAM-DICP can partially cope with dynamic motions, it may encounter challenges or fail to handle the narrow workspaces and intense motion on handheld or robot platforms, without the assistance of exteroception-irrelevant IMU sensors.
blocks.zh: 同样,STEAM-DICP只能成功运行到每个隧道序列的中点. 当平台执行一个U-turn to return时,STEAM-DICP由于场景狭窄,旋转速度快,键位不足而失败. 尽管与常规的LIO方法相比,STEAM-DICP在隧道序列上取得了一半的成功,但它仍然显示出明显的漂移错误,特别是在z z - 轴上. 我们只计算STEAM-DICP成功部分的RMSE. 从结果中得出的一个见解是,虽然STEAM-DICP的LiDAR-唯一连续时间模型可以部分地应对动态运动,但它可能会遇到挑战或无法处理手持式或机器人平台上狭窄的工作空间和剧烈运动,而没有exteroception-immus相关IMU传感器的帮助.

blocks.en: V-D Dynamic Point Removal and Static Mapping Results
blocks.zh: V-D 动态点清除和静态绘图结果

blocks.en: As described in Section IV-D , FMCW-LIO is capable of removing dynamic points and generating static maps according to the Doppler residual and the updated LiDAR velocity. The method operates at the point level rather than the semantic or object level, resulting in direct and efficient performance. The results and comparisons of dynamic point detection and static mapping are shown in Fig. 8 . It is obvious that, for conventional methods without removal, ghost points and residual blur of moving persons and buses may persist in the online map. Contrarily, FMCW-LIO can detect dynamic points (red points in Fig. 8 (c)(g)) in the current scan and finally retain points that are nearly static in the map. As a result, ghost points and blur artifacts do not manifest in the map generated by FMCW-LIO. More online results can be found in the video.
blocks.zh: 如第四节-D部分所述,FMCW-LIO能够按照多普勒残基和更新的LiDAR速度去除动态点并生成静态地图. 该方法在点级运行,而不是语义或对象级,导致直接高效的性能. 图8显示了动态点探测和静态绘图的结果和比较。 显然,对于没有移除的常规方法来说,在线地图中可能仍然存在鬼点和移动人员和公共汽车的残余模糊。 反之,FMCW-LIO可以在目前的扫描中检测动态点(图8(c)(g)中的红色点),并最终保留地图中几乎静止的点. 因此,幽灵点和模糊的文物并没有在FMCW-LIO生成的地图中表现出来. 更多在线结果可以在视频中找到.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: In this letter, the Doppler-aided FMCW-LIO is presented for robotic state estimation and mapping. To achieve accurate and robust state estimation, an on-manifold IESEKF is formulated, fusing IMU and FMCW Doppler LiDAR measurements. The motion compensation for Doppler measurements is addressed by the IMU-driven backward propagation. FMCW-LIO utilizes the inherent Doppler-aided LiDAR velocity observation, enabling robust state estimation and static mapping, even in severely narrow or structure-degenerated scenes. Diverse experiments on multiple platforms validate the effectiveness and show the superior performance of FMCW-LIO.
blocks.zh: 在这封信中,多普勒援助的FMCW-LIO被介绍用于机器人状态估计和绘图. 为实现准确和稳健的状态估计,制订了一个全方位的IESEKF,将IMU和FMCW Doppler LiDAR的测量结果相配合。 多普勒测量的运动补偿通过IMU驱动的落后传播来解决。 FMCW-LIO利用内在的多普勒辅助的LiDAR速度观测,使得能够进行强力的状态估计和静态绘图,即使在严重狭窄或结构脱落的场景中也是如此. 在多个平台上的多元实验验证了效果,显示了FMCW-LIO的优异性能.

blocks.en: F M C W - L I O is a unified and extensible LiDAR-inertial odometry framework that supports both 4D Doppler LiDARs and conventional 3D LiDARs. Built on a modular architecture design, the key framework components can be configured, extended, or replaced independently. Beyond the Doppler-aided estimation, F M C W - L I O also offers the following features: • Doppler Velocity Compensation : A Doppler compensation scheme aligns Doppler velocity measurements into a unified spatiotemporal frame. Beyond motion compensation, Doppler compensation essentially reveals the interrelation between the Doppler velocities of a static point with respect to arbitrary different frames. • Flexible Initialization : Multiple initialization algorithm and strategies are supported, including conventional stationary initialization and Free-Init , which delivers accurate initial states even in the presence of aggressive motion, moving objects, and structure degeneracy. • Multiple Integration and Multiple Motion Compensation Schemes : Various integration and motion compensation methods are provided, including second-order Runge-Kutta method (RK2), third-order Runge-Kutta method (RK3), fourth-order Runge-Kutta method (RK4), mechanization, and ACI2. • Robust Velocity Estimation : Multiple algorithms are integrated to improve the resilience and accuracy of velocity estimation, including least squares with RANSAC, covariance, and robust kernels. • Multiple Map Structures : Different map structures are supported, including ikd-Tree and iVox , enabling flexible and efficient mapping under varying conditions. • Multiple LiDAR Types : The framework is compatible with both 4D Doppler LiDARs and conventional 3D LiDARs, facilitating evaluation and deployment across different LiDAR sensing configurations.
blocks.zh: F M C W - L I O是一个统一且可扩展的LiDAR-惰性偏振框架,支持4D多普勒LiDARs和常规的3D LiDARs. 以模块化架构设计为基础,关键框架组件可以独立配置,扩展或替换. 除了多普勒辅助估计外,F M C W - L I O还提供以下特征: ——多普勒高速补偿:一个多普勒补偿计划将多普勒速率测量比对为统一的速率框架. 除了运动补偿之外,多普勒补偿基本上揭示了一个静态点的速度与任意不同框架之间的相互关系。 • 灵活初始化:支持多种初始化算法和战略,包括常规的固定初始化和Free-Init. 即使存在攻击性运动,移动物体,以及结构变质现象,也能提供准确的初始状态. • 多重融合和多重运动补偿计划:提供各种融合和运动补偿方法,包括第二顺序Runge-Kutta方法(RK2)、第三顺序Runge-Kutta方法(RK3)、第四顺序Runge-Kutta方法(RK4)、机械化和ACI2。 • 强速估计:将多种算法整合起来,以提高速度估计的韧性和准确性,包括与RANSAC最小的方形,共变,强力内核. • 多幅地图结构:支持不同的地图结构,包括ikd-Tree和iVox,以便在不同条件下灵活高效地绘制地图。 • 多种LiDAR 类型 : 该框架与4D多普勒LiDARs和常规的3DLiDARs兼容,有利于在不同的LiDAR感知配置中进行评价和部署.

blocks.en: In addition, the typical 4D FMCW Doppler LiDAR-inertial sequences collected in this work are also released as the FMCW-LIO Dataset and the Free-Init Dataset . FMCW-LIO Dataset provides five handheld sequences across campus, street, and tunnel scenes, covering both well-structured and structure-degenerated environments. Free-Init Dataset provides four handheld and vehicular sequences recorded under dynamic initial motions for the qualitative evaluation of dynamic initialization. Characteristics and download links of the sequences are listed and detailed on the respective project pages.
blocks.zh: 此外,本作中收集的典型的4D FMCW Dopler LiDAR-inertial序列也作为FMCW-LIO数据集和Free-Init数据集发布. FMCW-LIO Dataset提供5个跨校园,街道,和隧道场景的手持序列,既覆盖结构良好的环境,也覆盖结构脱产的环境. Free-Init Datas集提供在动态初始运动下记录的4个手持和车辆序列,用于动态初始化的质量评价. 序列的特征和下载链接在相应的项目页面上列出和详细.
